subject: Media Literacy
title: AI-Generated Media
description: A quick win: understand AI-Generated Media.

hook.text: An AI-generated image of the Pope in a puffer jacket went viral in 2023. Millions thought it was real.

buildup.text: AI can now generate text, images, audio, and video that are increasingly hard to distinguish from reality.

discovery.text: This means the cost of creating convincing media has dropped to nearly zero.

twist.text: When anyone can create realistic fake media, trust in all media erodes — even real content looks suspicious.

climax.text: AI doesn't just create media. It's destroying our ability to trust what we see.

punchline.text: When fakes look real, reality looks fake.

quiz.question: What is the broader impact of AI-generated media?
options: It erodes trust in all media, even authentic content
